study_design: Case-control comparison of prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia patients with controls
reason: The study compares blood biomarkers in existing prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia cases with controls. It does not report an aggressive prostate cancer subtype or prospective incident aggressive disease.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Blood levels of zinc and copper were significantly lower in PCA and BPH cases when compared with controls (P < 0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: The blood zinc comparison includes general prostate cancer cases and provides no aggressive disease classification.
